summary: FortexaERP Sync History/Log feature tested successfully. Backend: 8/8 tests passed (sync-log endpoint, authentication, entry fields, limit parameter, logging). Frontend: All UI components verified (View History button, Sync History dialog with logo, empty state message, table structure).
context_for_next_testing_agent: FortexaERP Sync History feature fully implemented. The sync log is stored in MongoDB collection 'fortexaerp_sync_log'. To see entries in the log: 1) Configure FortexaERP in Company Config > Integrations, 2) Attempt a sync via POST /api/fortexaerp/sync-journal-entries (will fail with external API but logs 'failed' entry), or 3) Successfully sync a journal entry (logs 'success' entry). The View History button only appears when ERP is configured.
